## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `dd527b97cb8d2e717fa3c1d70bc18331f43c21f0`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-automation/references/state-machines-and-approvals.md, skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json + none
Security-touching: yes
Rule-change-verified: none

Inputs read: card #36161 (body, its 5 comments, its label timeline), PR #36559 (body, 3-file list, net diff), the check-runs on this head, and the cited code on `main` at `ad50d611`. Merge-base is `d463c46f`; neither `hits` file, the changeset path, `rule-validator.ts`, `validate-inert-object-declarations.ts` nor `validation.zod.ts` changed between the two, so the PR diff is the net diff against `main`.

Check-runs at 2026-11-22T23:34:06Z: 48 runs, 30 success, 18 skipped, 0 red, 0 in progress (`Test Core (1/10)` was still running at the first read and completed green at 23:33:19Z; the `Test Core` roll-up followed). Read green, among them: `Check Changeset` (both runs), `PR-body guards` (both runs, the second after the body edit of 23:25Z), `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Type Check · source gates` (token ratchet, skill-refs, served-sections, frame-sync, compatibility, links), `Lint · docs & code guards` (role-word, identifier-liveness), `Build Core`, `Type Check · consumer gates`, `Test Core (1/10)`, `Test Core (2/10)`, `Test Core`, and the other Lint and Type Check jobs.

The security line above reads yes, and yes is meant. The path name shows a workflow reference; the changed hunks teach where a server-side write-path lock does and does not refuse a write: the new entry tells an author how to open an exit from a state (`''` in its targets), and the reworded entry beside it restates that an unlisted stored state is not guarded. The lock binds an elevated caller too (`engine-state-machine-stored-state.test.ts`, "an elevated caller is judged the same way"), the rule this teaches was narrowed by the security seat (PR #36127), and the card says decisions on the same machine are pending with that seat. That is enforcement behaviour, so the low-risk arm does not apply. The card has never carried the `security` label (timeline read); the adopting seat adds it.

The rule-change line above reads none: the file list holds no `.claude/**` path (one changeset, two `skills/**` files), and no hunk alters what an agent may do, the order of work, or what goes to the maintainer.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept-set: unchanged, right. No schema or code file is in the diff. `StateMachineValidationSchema.transitions` is `z.record(z.string(), z.array(z.string()))` (`packages/spec/src/data/validation.zod.ts:196`), so the taught `paused: ['open', '']` already parses and type-checks against `StateMachineValidation`; no lint rule judges a target against the field's options (`validate-inert-object-declarations.ts` and `validate-seed-state-machine.ts` read).
- Public surface, `@objectstack/skills` reference text: one added note, the section intro and six notes reworded. Right. No heading or anchor changes, the `os:check` block sits outside every hunk, the file is 23734 bytes (23726 on the merge-base), under the untouched ceiling row 5936 at `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs:1808`.
- Eval grading set, case `objectstack-data/objects-fields-relationships#3`: `must_contain` gains `initialStates`. This narrows what the grader passes (`grade.ts`: a literal, case-sensitive substring), right: publish refuses a machine that runs on insert without it at severity `error` (`validate-inert-object-declarations.ts:57-66`), the data skill teaches the token (`skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md:327`, `rules/validation.md:103-113`), and the sibling order case already requires `initialStates: ['draft']`.
- Eval case hash: `hashCase` covers the prompt and both token lists (`cases.ts`), so case 3's hash moves and `--regrade` refuses earlier run records of this case as changed since the turn ran (`run.ts:372-388`). Right, and the designed reading; `expected_output` is neither sent nor graded.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/36161-automation-skill-clearable-state.md` declares `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`; the PR body carries the same two lines. The diff publishes skill prose and one eval fixture: no accept-set, export, type or runtime behaviour moves, so `patch` and `Clause-②: no` match what is published, and `Metadata-protocol: none` holds (no protocol file in the list). `@objectstack/skills` is in the fixed group and takes a changeset, not `skip-changeset`; the sibling `.changeset/36285-relationships-predicate-floor.md` on `main` has the same shape. `Check Changeset` is green on both runs.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev flags, from the report naming this head (comment 7087555372):

1. Commit trailer without a model name: answered. Both commits carry `Claude-Session:` and `Co-authored-by: Claude`, the pair `AGENTS.md:451` prescribes.
2. Skill wording narrower than the card (`constraint.to: ''`, "any other listed state"): answered, and the narrower wording is the correct one. See ④.
3. Five build-dependent gates not measured locally: answered by CI. `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content` and `check:lean-entry-closure` run in `Build Core`, `check:doc-formula-expressions` in `Type Check · consumer gates`; both green.
4. Two tokens of headroom spent, ceiling row untouched: answered. The ratchet file is not in the file list and the ratchet step is green in `Type Check · source gates`.
5. PR body footer form: prose face; `PR-body guards` green.
6. File surface: the eval file is outside the claim's declared surface (claim comment 7087169995 names one file and says stop on breach). Answered for this record: the PR body carries a `Ride-along:` line, `PR-body guards` (single-writer path) is green after that edit, the file is a `hits` path and is reviewed in full below, and PR #36560 from the source card #36534 does not touch it. Left to the adopting seat: the claim comment still names one file; say so in the ACCEPT.
7. PR body not patched by the dev: answered. The body read at 23:25:48Z names head `dd527b97` and carries the ride-along paragraph.
8. No merge of `main`: answered above; the net diff is the PR diff.

`open_questions`: empty.

Out-of-scope finding carried by the dev as "noted, not filed": the Studio validations panel drops `''`. Confirmed on `main`: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectValidationsPanel.tsx:597` ends the target parse with `.filter(Boolean)`, so a row edit removes a listed `''` and the clear is refused again. An issue search found no card for it, and `Fixes #36161` closes the only card that carries the note. Escalated to the adopting seat: route it to the ui lane through the filing gate before this lands, or name the card that already holds it.

Reviewer flag: one item goes to the security seat through the private channel; it is not held against this head and the skill text does not widen it.

SQL push-down: no query, id materialisation or join in the diff.

PR author is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`.

### ④ Design judgment

**`skills/objectstack-automation/references/state-machines-and-approvals.md`**, against `checkStateMachine` on `main` (`packages/objectql/src/validation/rule-validator.ts:4166-4264`) and the card's owed sentence.

New entry, clause by clause:

- "Clearing the field is a transition to `''`": lines 4243 and 4251, `cleared = isEmptyStateValue(to)`, `toKey = cleared ? '' : String(to)`. Holds.
- "An update to `null` or `''` is judged from the stored state": `from = previous[rule.field]` (4236); `isEmptyStateValue` takes `undefined`, `null` and `''` (4267). Holds.
- "a clearable state lists `''` in its targets, e.g. `paused: ['open', '']`": `allowed.includes('')` (4252). The example is the fixture of `engine-state-machine-stored-state.test.ts:59` and of `content/docs/protocol/objectql/state-machine.mdx:110`. Holds.
- "from any other listed state it is refused (`invalid_transition`, `constraint.to: ''`)": line 4255 answers `fallback('invalid_transition', { from: fromKey, to: toKey }, …)`, and both arms of `fallback` put that pair under `constraint`, with or without an authored `message`. "listed" is required: line 4249 returns `null` when the stored state is not a key. The card's "any other state" and bare `to: ''` would both have been wrong; the diff's wording is right.

Acceptance scenario: the card's re-check, `git grep -n "''"` on the file, now answers the entry; the triage ruling's case (an app built from the skill refuses a user who clears the state field) is answered by the taught target.

Attempts to break it:

- An already-empty state written empty again: `from === to` returns first (4242) and the test's control covers it. The entry speaks of listed states and stays true.
- A non-blocking machine: the entry, like every note in the section, describes the default `severity: 'error'` rule. Unchanged premise.
- The first client of a `''` target: `ui/packages/core/src/validation/validators/state-machine-next-values.ts` builds a string set from the targets and treats an empty current value as unconstrained; a `''` member is inert there. Holds.
- The seed lint adds each target to its state set as a string (`validate-seed-state-machine.ts:74-78`); a `''` target is not refused there.

Reworded passages, each checked for a lost fact: the intro and the "enforced on the write path" sentence (same claim, 4252-4255); one rule per field; `initialStates` gating insert, the publish refusal and the update-only exemption (`validation.zod.ts:197`, `validate-inert-object-declarations.ts:42-66`); guards as sibling `script` / `conditional` rules and reactions as a `record_change` flow under ADR-0019; the introspection route with `next: null` and "always pass `from`"; the unguarded unlisted `from` state (4249); the `record.` scope of sibling predicates. Every fact is still stated. What went is rationale only ("instead of hard-coding it", "rather than relying on an implicit any → any") and the label "record-triggered Flow", whose identifier `record_change` stays.

**`skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json`**, case 3, against the lint rule and the data skill on `main`.

- `initialStates: ['draft']` for a `draft → active → terminated` machine with default `events`: the rule refuses the old expected answer (`rule.type === 'state_machine'`, `runsOnInsert(undefined)` is true, no `initialStates`, severity `error`), so the old `expected_output` modelled a shape publish refuses. The new one is right, and `draft` is the entry state the prompt names.
- "`transitions` governs only UPDATE … (`state-machine-no-initial-states`)": matches `validation.zod.ts:197` and `rule-explanations.ts:6519-6530`.
- `must_contain` + `initialStates`: attainable from the skill under test (`SKILL.md:327`), and looser than the sibling's `initialStates: ['draft']`, so an answer that quotes the list with other quote marks still passes.
- The file parses and every `must_contain` token of case 3 is present in its `expected_output`.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

- N1 (nit) — eval case 3, "publish refuses a machine that runs on insert without it": the nearest nouns before "it" are `message` and `transitions`; `initialStates` is meant. The rule id in the parenthesis settles the reading and `expected_output` is neither sent nor graded. Accepted deviation.
- N2 (nit) — the entry's example state `paused` is not one of the five states of the `os:check` block above it. It is marked "e.g." and mirrors the docs page and the engine test. Accepted deviation.

## 维护者速读
自动化技能补了一句：状态字段要允许「清空」，得在那个状态的可去目标里写上空值；其它状态下清空会被拒绝。这是 #36127 落地后的行为，技能原来没教，AI 照旧写出的应用会拒掉清空状态的用户。
顺带修了数据技能的一道评测参考答案：它示范的状态机没写起始状态，按现在的规则发布会被拒。
两层审核都通过，CI 全绿，改动 64 行。因为契约审核判它涉及写入锁的教法（Security-touching: yes），走人工批准。
